name: Recallyn – Product Recall Manager for WooCommerce
author: Berkay Yavuz

sections.description:
Recallyn helps WooCommerce store owners handle product recalls in an organised way. Create a recall, find every customer who bought the affected products in a date range, email them a clear notice with a personal response link, and track who has read the notice or asked for a refund or a replacement.

Features

  • Recalls screen with reason, customer instructions, risk level (low, medium, high), status (draft, active, closed), affected products and variations, and a sales date range.
  • Find affected buyers in completed and processing orders. Orders are scanned in small batches in the background with Action Scheduler, so large stores do not time out.
  • Notification email with an editable template and placeholders: {customer_name}, {product_name}, {order_number}, {recall_reason}, {instructions}, {response_link}, {store_name}. The email uses your WooCommerce email design.
  • Test email to yourself before you email customers. Emails are sent in batches in the background.
  • Personal response link that works without logging in. Customers choose “I have read this notice”, “I want a refund” or “I want a replacement” and can add a note. The response is also added to the order as a note.
  • Tracking screen with emails sent, responses by type and the list of customers who have not responded, plus a button to email them again.
  • Product page warning for active recalls, readable by screen readers, with an option to stop sales of the affected products.
  • Public notices page with the [recallyn_notices] shortcode.
  • Privacy tools: personal data export and erasure, and suggested privacy policy text.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Shortcode

[recallyn_notices] lists active and closed recalls. Options:
  • status="active" or status="closed" to show only one group (default: both).
  • limit="20" to set the maximum number of recalls shown.

Pro version

An optional Pro version adds automatic reminder emails, CSV and printable reports, lot or batch number recalls, a logo and button colour for emails, email text per language, and a response rate chart. Every feature listed above stays fully available in this free version without limits.

External services

This plugin includes the Freemius SDK to manage the optional Pro license and, only if you agree on the opt-in screen, to send basic usage data (site URL, WordPress, PHP and plugin versions, admin email). Nothing is sent if you skip the opt-in. Freemius terms: https://freemius.com/terms/ and privacy policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/

Recall data (customer names, email addresses and responses) is stored in your own database and is never sent to an external service.
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  2. Install the plugin from the Plugins screen, or upload the recallyn folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Go to Recalls → Add New Recall, describe the recall, choose the affected products and publish it.
  5. Click Find affected buyers, then open Recalls → Buyers & tracking to send a test email and email the buyers.
sections.faq:
Does it work with HPOS?

Yes. Orders are read through the WooCommerce order API, so both HPOS and the legacy order storage are supported.

Will sending many emails slow down my store?

No. Order scans and emails run in the background in small batches with Action Scheduler. You can change the number of emails per batch in Recalls → Settings.

Do customers need an account to respond?

No. Each customer receives a unique, hard-to-guess link that works without logging in.

Which orders are included?

Completed and processing orders that contain an affected product or variation and were placed within the recall’s sales date range.

Can I stop selling a recalled product?

Yes. Tick “Stop sales of the affected products while this recall is active” on the recall screen. The product page shows the warning and the product cannot be added to the cart.

What happens to my data when I delete the plugin?

Nothing is deleted unless you enable “Remove data” in Recalls → Settings. Then all recalls, buyers, responses and settings are removed when you delete the plugin.
